Fixes DXM-797

Adds a callout clarifying that the `directive @... on ...` definitions
in the @composeDirective example are required, not illustrative — the
`url` in a custom @link is never fetched, unlike Apollo's own specs
(@key, @connect, etc.). Raised by a customer who read the example as
implying version-only custom directives were possible.

Please make sure you're targeting the federation version you're opening

when submitting a pull request. Make sure existing tests still pass, and

        tests for all new behavior.

Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to what

to

Fixes DXM-797

Adds a callout clarifying that the `directive @... on ...` definitions
in the @composeDirective example are required, not illustrative — the
`url` in a custom @link is never fetched, unlike Apollo's own specs
(@key, @connect, etc.). Raised by a customer who read the example as
implying version-only custom directives were possible.
